title: Slow down, please
hints: Keep two pieces of state in `make_rate_limiter`: when the current window started (nothing yet at first) and how many calls it has allowed. `allow` reads and updates them.
`allow` rebinds those variables, so it needs `nonlocal window_start, used`. On each call: read `now = clock()`; if there's no window yet or `now - window_start >= window`, start a new one.

if window_start is None or now - window_start >= window: window_start, used = now, 0
if used < limit: used += 1; return True
return False
